question: How are the eight kṣetras correlated with the body?
premises: Knowers of the kṣetras speak of an eightfold group.
This group corresponds to the eight petals of the heart-lotus.
Prayāga, Varaṇā, Aṭṭahāsa, and Jayantikā are among them.
inference: The eight outer kṣetras are mapped onto the eight petals of the heart-lotus.
uncertainties: Only four of the eight kṣetras are named in this verse.
plain_english: Those who know the kṣetras speak of an eightfold group corresponding to the eight petals of the heart-lotus: Prayāga, Varaṇā, then Aṭṭahāsa, and Jayantikā.
